verdict.rationale: Pigment's MCP server page says agent access is "scoped by role, model, or metric" and that admins approve which assistants connect. That is a first-party least-privilege control for AI agents, but nothing documents issuing distinct API credentials or tokens for an agent. Fine-grained data access rights support the scoping model only indirectly. Missing for 10: documented issuance of agent-specific API keys/tokens, per-credential scope configuration, rotation/revocation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
